signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a single-story ranch-style house frontage from the street, with the full facade, lawn, and driveway visible.
signals.notes: Well-kept single-story ranch with sage-green siding, an attached garage, and a neatly mowed lawn with trimmed shrubs. Two parked sedans/SUVs are in the driveway, and there is no sign of work vehicles, signage, or construction.
